dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides sewer pipe network information for Westbank First Nation (WFN) and supports management of sewer infrastructure within the service area. It includes line features representing sewer pipes and associated asset details used for asset tracking and network reference.

Feature Content

  • WFN Sewer Pipes — line features representing sewer pipe assets with identifiers, pipe characteristics, ownership and source information, operational status, location references, and network connectivity attributes.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation (WFN) sewer infrastructure within the Central Okanagan in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Inventory and reference of sewer pipe assets
  • Network mapping and utility operations
  • Asset management and maintenance planning
  • Support for engineering, infrastructure planning, and field coordination

Source and Access

Westbank First Nation owns and maintains the data which is hosted by the Regional District of Central Okanagan and is shared under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License.
